Huawei Cloud DWS Memory High Diagnosis Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for diagnosing high memory usage in DWS clusters.
- Automatically analyzes memory alarms, OOM issues, and high memory usage scenarios to produce standardized diagnosis reports.
- Integrates with KooCLI (hcloud) v3.2.0+ and DWS Autopilot MCP Server, with automatic fallback based on availability.
- Enforces strict diagnosis/reporting rules: output only reflects tool results; remediation suggestions and custom SQL outputs are not included.
- Supports a comprehensive list of memory-related trigger words for flexible invocation.
